description:
- Replace the extra account-list shelves with recommended movies and TV shows based on titles in your linked Trakt and SIMKL accounts.
- Generate recommendations through TMDB, filtering out titles already present in connected libraries or local viewing history.
- Keep imported playback progress in the main top history/Continue Watching row. Remove the redundant lower Continue Watching and Up Next sections.
- Keep connected-account lists available in Library.
- Allow recommendation sections to be hidden or reordered in Home settings.
- Cache recommendations for offline use and clear a provider's recommendation cache when it disconnects.
- Show the stacked new-episode badge on series cards across sections, including the main history/progress row.
- Update visible badges when episode counts change and preserve them when cards are recycled or reattached.
- Keep the history card's episode label and progress bar alongside its badge.
- Keep the existing count: aired, unwatched episodes after your latest watched episode, using Phantom history or Trakt/SIMKL.
- Fix badge updates when the same show appears on multiple cards or sections.
- Support matching addon IMDb identities with TMDB viewing history.
- Add badge support to the remaining series-card adapters, including favorites, trending, similar shows, and cast-related shows.
- Show local and imported history in the top row without requiring a Phantom cloud login.
